scenarios.name: Return a staged command to a different source category

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon customization dialog has an empty Part Tools target
the command source is All Commands
the user double-clicks 2D Sketches in the source list
2D Sketches appears in the target and is absent from the visible source list
the target is marked as changed
the user selects View Tab as the command source
2D Sketches remains in the target and is absent from the visible View Tab source list
the user double-clicks 2D Sketches in the target
2D Sketches appears in the View Tab source list
the target remains marked as changed
